description: This file implements the core functions of the Bmc2 Environment Controller Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization of the object. It contains functions for managing internal components, setting interface pointers, and establishing object properties for environment management within a broader management console system.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE Bmc2EnvcoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new Bmc2 Environment Controller Object, setting up its core properties and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2EnvcoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the Bmc2 Environment Controller Object and its associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2EnvcoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls subordinate objects and interfaces required by the environment controller, such as command interfaces.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS Bmc2EnvcoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the environment controller object, setting internal properties, function pointers, and preparing it for operation.
